card.name: Adverb endings like -ly after stems
card.fires_on: The -ly or -ably ending of an adverb split into pieces, such as toler-ably, skil-fully, rich-ly, and G-ently at the start of a handling instruction. Also fires on 'with' after 'together'.

modes.label: Split adverb ending
modes.description: The -ly style ending of an adverb whose stem came just before, often before a participle or adjective.
modes.example: the rich<<ly>> decorated minber, or pulpit,

modes.label: Gently in instructions
modes.description: The 'ently' piece after a capital G at the start of a preparation or application step.
modes.example: 2 DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION G<<ently>> wash the face and neck with a mild

modes.label: Together with
modes.description: The word 'with' right after 'together' in a list of rights.
modes.example: erecting temporary buildings for curing them; together<< with>> the privilege of hunting

card.plain: It marks the ending of an adverb like 'gently' or 'richly' when the word is split into parts.
